card.name: Scattered punctuation and digits before Africa-related text
card.fires_on: Mixed spots: commas after author-and-year citations, the word Trinidad, and digits or spaces inside numbers. The common thread is a weak link to African place names in the output.

modes.label: Citation comma

modes.description: The word Trinidad in a sentence about Caribbean events.
